chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Prophet (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said: For everything there is an ornament, and the ornament of the Quran is the beautiful voice.

key_terms.الصَّوْت الحَسَن: The beautiful/melodious voice — specifically referring to a voice that is pleasant and melodious when reciting Quran, not merely any pleasant sound
key_terms.حِلْيَة: Ornament, adornment, jewel — something that beautifies or enhances; used here metaphorically for the relationship between the Quran and a beautiful voice

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the ornament of the Quran?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) transmits this prophetic hadith in which the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) compares the Quran to a precious object that is enhanced by its proper adornment — a beautiful, melodious recitation voice. The hadith encourages Muslims to beautify their Quran recitation, indicating that a pleasant voice is not merely aesthetic but is itself a form of reverence and honor for the divine word. Early Muslim scholars understood this as encouragement for tajwid (proper Quranic recitation) and for seeking those with beautiful voices to lead recitation.

en.hubeali: From him, from Ali Bin Ma’bad, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Abdullah Bin Sinan,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘For everything is an ornament, and an ornament of the Quran is the beautiful voice’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ali Ma’bad from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Qasim from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Holy Prophet has said, ‘For everything there is an ornament, the ornament of (reading) the Holy Quran is attractive tone of voice.’”
